description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score over epochs for three different experimental conditions: "Regular members," "Members with near-duplicates," and "Held-out data." The x-axis, labeled "Epochs," is scaled linearly from 0 to 3, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU score," is also linear and ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Regular members" (blue line) starts at a BLEU score of approximately 0.04 and shows a steady, gradual increase, reaching a score of about 0.19 by epoch 3. The "Members with near-duplicates" (orange line) begins at a BLEU score of approximately 0.04 and exhibits a sharp, non-linear increase, rising to a score of about 0.36 by epoch 3. The "Held-out data" (green line) starts at a BLEU score of approximately 0.04 and increases gradually, reaching a score of about 0.16 by epoch 3.
